text:
maria: FYI - seeing rising tail latency for streaming tokens on /v1/chat/stream (dedicated-us-west). 95/99p up ~40-60ms over baseline since yesterday. Attaching profiler sample.

aj: link to perf dashboard?

maria: https://console.redwood/perf/dash?route=/v1/chat/stream - note the token-level split: decode | kv_fetch | kernel | network_send

devon: grabbed a sampling run. Kernel selection flip observed at ~0.6s mark — fallback to fp16-kernel-b when seq_len>512. pprof shows hot path in attention kernel.

devon: snippet:
```
func: attention_forward  -> 42.3%  (kernel_fp16_b)
kv_lookup -> 18.7%
serialize -> 12.1%
```

kai: interesting — KV cache hit rate dropped from 98% -> 83% around the same time. That would increase kv_fetch latency and force different batching patterns.

sasha: do we have client vs server timing breakdown? Could be client chunking causing micro-bursts that break batching windows.

maria: yes, added per-request timing trace. server_token_ms breakdown:
- token_decode_ms
- token_kv_fetch_ms
- token_kernel_ms
- token_send_ms

perf-bot: trace 1748001111.3 created: /traces/1748001111.3

aj: any regression in batching heuristic? maybe the burst detector threshold is too low and we're flushing small batches.

devon: profiling suggests batching-flush count increased 3x. Current heuristic: flush_after=10ms or max_batch=64. For streaming small chunk sizes we hit flush_after more often.

sasha: propose heuristic tweak: adaptive_flush = max(3ms, 0.5 * median_interarrival) so we coalesce micro-bursts. Also consider delaying kernel switch until sustained seq_len shift for 50 requests.

kai: +1. We should also instrument kv cache eviction rate per model-version — if cache is thrashing that explains hit rate drop.

maria: created issue: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/issues/2142 - will add KV eviction metric, per-route token latency panels, and canary for adaptive_flush.

aj: who will own the canary? recommend devon for kernel gating and sasha for batching.

devon: I can take kernel gating. I'll push a canary config:
```
replica_count: 2
kernel_policy:
  gating_window: 120s
  min_samples: 200
```

sasha: I'll add the adaptive_flush toggle with a rollout flag.

maria: timeline? let's aim for internal canary in 2 days, wider rollouts next week. Add regression alert: token_latency.kv_fetch_ms > 30ms for 5m.

kai: I'll add dashboard panels and alert.

maria: Thx all. tagging @eng-oncall in case we see 500s :eyes:
